name: The black lichen band (Verrucaria)
plain: A black band of lichen runs along the rock just above the high-tide line, in the splash zone, below the orange lichens.
confidence: medium: curves from World's levels/downeast/coast_rules.json (21 Oct), checked against the Bar Harbor shore and cited above; Matt's field corrections still to come

sources.note: the black Verrucaria zone at and just above high water, below the orange belt; grey crustose and foliose lichens above it
